modules.title: 填进表单的每一项，都变成记录里的一个字段
字段清单对界面与逻辑的决定作用

items.title: 字段决定表单
items.text: 表单上每个输入框对应一个字段。清单里有四个字段，新建页面就只有四项要填，不会多也不会少。

items.title: 字段决定列表
items.text: 列表的每一列就是一个字段。想清楚「以后要按什么找」，就把什么设成字段。

items.title: 字段决定校验
items.text: 金额必须是数字、日期必须能被选中——校验规则跟着字段走，而不是跟着页面走。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 字段是信息本身，输入框是填写它的控件，表单是一组字段的填写界面——三层不要混。字段名回答「记什么」，数据类型回答「什么格式」，也是两件事。宁可先少字段：每增加一个字段，录入表单、列表展示列、校验规则与移动端适配都要同步增加处理成本。

lessonPractice.title: 设计报价工具时，下面哪个属于字段？

options.label: 每条报价的「金额」
options.feedback: 对。金额是每条记录里单独的一项信息，是字段；客户名、日期、状态也是字段。

options.label: 表单底部的「保存」按钮
options.feedback: 按钮是操作入口，不是被记录的信息。字段指信息本身，不指控件。

options.label: 整张新建报价的表单
options.feedback: 表单是填写一组字段的界面；字段是表单里的单项信息。

en.title: While designing a quote tool, which of these is a field?

options.label: The "amount" of each quote
options.feedback: Correct. Amount is one standalone piece of information per record; client name, date, and status are fields too.

options.label: The "save" button at the bottom of the form
options.feedback: A button is an action entry, not recorded information. A field is the information itself, not the control.

options.label: The entire new-quote form
options.feedback: The form is the interface for filling in a group of fields; a field is one item inside it.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 报价工具先只做这四个字段：客户名、金额、日期、跟进状态。客户名和金额必填，日期用日期选择，状态从「跟进中、已成交、已归档」里选。先不要加其他字段。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Keep the quote tool to four fields for now: client name, amount, date, and status. Name and amount are required, date uses a date picker, status picks from "following up / won / archived." Do not add other fields yet.

learning.assumes: You have filled in web forms and seen the label above each input.
learning.outcome: You can split "what to record" into a named field list, and tell fields apart from input controls and the form as a whole.

modules.title: Every form item becomes one field in the record
How the field list drives everything after it

items.title: Fields drive the form
items.text: Each input on the form maps to one field. Four fields means the create page asks for exactly four things.

items.title: Fields drive the list
items.text: Each column in the list is a field. Whatever you will search by later should be a field now.

items.title: Fields drive validation
items.text: Amount must be a number, date must be pickable—validation follows the field, not the page.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: The field is the information itself, the input is the control for entering it, and the form is the interface for a group of fields—three different layers. A field name answers "what to record" while a data type answers "what format"—also two different things. Prefer fewer fields first: every added field grows the form, the list, validation, and the mobile layout.

distinctions.label: Input
distinctions.text: {c:input} is the control used to type a field's value; {c:field} is the piece of information itself.

distinctions.label: Data type
distinctions.text: {c:field} answers "what to record"; {c:data-type} answers "what format that information takes".
